about: 12 labelled SOC alerts for a security-alert triage exercise.

alerts.alert: An executable spawns a powershell with a hidden window and a command that downloads and launches a script from an untrusted external host
alerts.note: Critical malware concern, executing code from an unknown source, should be escalated

alerts.alert: An account was created and added to the local administrator group outside the approved change window
alerts.note: Unexpected privilege escalation could indicate unauthorized access attempts

alerts.alert: Unsigned process opens LSASS with memory-read access and writes an unknown dump file
Unknown principal creates a new access key for a production IAM user and gives admin access from an address not seen for that account
alerts.note: Could indicate account takeover from an unknown location, requires investigation

alerts.alert: A service account requested service tickets for 4,800 distinct user accounts in 2 minutes; the same account usually requests fewer than 20 tickets per hour
alerts.note: Unexpected volume of tickets should be investigated

alerts.alert: Known vulnerability signature detected against legacy web portal, followed by an outbound connection to an unknown external address
alerts.note: Unexpected outbound communication following a known vulnerability suggests compromised accounts

alerts.alert: One failed sign-in for a user from known location, followed two minutes later by a successful sign-in from the same device
alerts.note: Routine, password entered incorrectly but successfully signed in after one attempt

alerts.alert: Application installer quarantined during the approved deployment; the file hash matches the change ticket's documented test artifact
alerts.note: Defender found a potential threat but it was identified as approved, so all ok

alerts.alert: Production-readonly automation role calls several functions from its usual workload identity during its scheduled nightly run
alerts.note: Typical and expected functionality from existing identity

alerts.alert: Malicious EICAR test string discovered on network, file was generated by approved anti-virus job and immediately quarantined
TCP SYN probes detected against the company's staging subnet, matching the security team's scheduled vulnerability scan window
alerts.note: Expected activity during documented test window

alerts.alert: Logged installation of Windows service by signed enterprise software deployment agent during approved window
alerts.note: Enterprise deployment agent during approved window is ok
